source: Revision 5.1 Acid Soil Correction, Main Farm
meta.precedence: Where Rev 5.1 and Rev 5 disagree, Rev 5.1 wins.

zones.note: former open field, now the nursery; not a cropping block
Rukpokwu extension; 40 cm single row on ridges

gates.name: Ground Clearance
pass_all: soil + nematode lab report returned CLEAR
soil pH 5.5-7.0 from a three-point test on file (with meter photo)
Farm Doctor check passed, confirmed by Farm Manager and approved by Owner
gates.on_fail: remediate (solarise / biofumigant / re-site / lime) and re-test

gates.name: Establishment Readiness
pass_all: full input list on-site incl. thrips controls
yellow sticky traps installed (1 per 6 m2)
Route B blocks: 14+ days since hydrated lime
seedling batch passed the nursery release check (OF-02)
gates.source: Rev 5 p3, p17, p20; Rev 5.1 p3

gates.name: Diagnosis before Treatment
pass_all: a diagnosis entry exists and precedes any spray entry
gates.flow: symptom -> diagnostic protocol -> confirmed cause -> matched remedy
gates.unconfirmed: route to Farm Doctor photo review; if still unconfirmed or a lab-only cause is suspected, send a lab sample and notify Owner

kpis.proof: cleared lab report (and pH, per 5.1) on file before any transplant
kpis.red_flag: planting started with no soil report

kpis.proof: daily trap counts logged; threshold-cross to spray under 24 h
kpis.red_flag: trap counts gapped >2 days, or thrips reach 'heavy' with no prior alert
owner learns of a problem from a dead plant, not an alert

kpis.proof: every treatment has a diagnosis recorded before it
kpis.red_flag: a spray logged with no preceding diagnosis

thresholds.action: Thiamethoxam (IRAC 4A) or next group in rotation at the next spray window (max 24 h)

thresholds.trigger: >10 per trap OR >3 per growing tip
thresholds.action: same-day rotation spray, Spinosad (IRAC 5) preferred, after 4 PM; re-count to confirm knockdown
spray + rotate IRAC; neem/soap for light pressure; cut infested tips
Chlorantraniliprole (IRAC 28) 0.5 ml/L, 4-7 PM; log 'IRAC 28 - pod-borer threshold'
thresholds.escalate: >10 plants with entry holes -> spray whole field today
thresholds.scope: open field, perimeter plants, from Week 3

thresholds.action: advance the scheduled spray; do not wait for the threshold

thresholds.trigger: any presence confirmed with a 10x loupe
thresholds.action: red alert; Abamectin (IRAC 6) or wettable sulphur on tips within 24 h; bag worst tips

thresholds.trigger: webbing seen, OR mites confirmed on >5% of plants
thresholds.action: alert; rotate miticide within 24 h; fix drought/dust stress
thresholds.watch: isolated specks -> yellow watch, re-check in 3 days

scouting.sample: 10 plants per house (leaf undersides, growing tips, stem base)
scouting.traps: yellow sticky, 1 per 6 m2 at plant height, installed before transplant
scouting.field_extra: perimeter and windward edge first; pod-borer check weekly from Week 3; crown check for Phytophthora

frequency.full_round: weekly on Day 2 (10 plants per house; field perimeter first)
frequency.extra_watch: GH-04 and GH-05: full round twice weekly (Day 2 and Day 5) for the first 3 weeks after replant
frequency.missed_trap_count: not logged by end of day -> yellow to Field Supervisor; 2 consecutive days missed -> red to Owner

insecticide_rotation.rule: never the same IRAC group twice in a row; check last group before mixing

fungicide_rotation.rule: never the same FRAC group twice in a row; Metalaxyl-M only in rotation, max every 3rd

sequence.note: dry leaves; needs 2 dry hours to bind

other_products_named.rotation: logged as 'wound care'; excluded from the FRAC rotation check and interval count

fungicide_rotation.week_10_exception: From Week 10, Copper Hydroxide (M1) is the only PHI-0 fungicide, so repeated M1 is allowed at 10-14 day intervals. Multi-site M groups carry low resistance risk. This is the only exception to 'never the same FRAC twice'.

spray_rules.rule: Flowering onward: spray only after 5 PM; never onto open flowers; never in wind through the nets.
Postpone if leaves are wet; Mancozeb needs 2 dry hours to bind.
Open field: if more than 15 mm of rain falls within 4 h after a spray, create a re-spray task for the next dry window.
Microbial inoculant (Trichoderma etc.) never within 48 h of any fungicide; never in the same tank.
PPE: mask + gloves for sprays; hydrated lime requires goggles, gloves, dust mask, long sleeves, and a logged team briefing.
From Week 10 (both crops): organics only - neem oil, garlic-chilli, Copper Hydroxide. No synthetic insecticide within 14 days of harvest; keep a 21-day buffer for export. Stop Metalaxyl-M.

phi.rei_default: until spray has dried, minimum 4 h (garlic-chilli: eye/skin irritant)

phi.product: Any other synthetic (Mancozeb, Copper Oxychloride, Metalaxyl-M, Spinosad, Abamectin, sulphur, etc.)

rei.rule: Label value, once entered, is used only if it is longer than the default. The spray screen shows every PHI/REI; a missing label value shows the default marked 'default — check label'.
rei.harvest_block: harvest tasks in a zone are blocked until the longest PHI of any product applied there has passed
rei.week_10_rule: from Week 10, synthetics cannot be selected at all (Rev 5)

mixing_rules.never: Ca Nitrate + K Nitrate in the same tank
mixing_rules.do: separate passes; flush between (white precipitate blocks emitters)
premix 150 ml oil + 30 ml soap; use within 8 h

mixing_rules.never: Foliar Ca after first open flower
Zinc above 2 g/L if grey sheen appears

soil_ph_gate.test: three points per block; meter calibrated that morning at pH 4.0 and 7.0; 1:1 soil to distilled water, stirred, 10 min; photo of meter
soil_ph_gate.below_5_2: apply half the original rate again, add 10 days; never stack a full dose
soil_ph_gate.treat_area: greenhouse: bed area only; open field: full cropped area
soil_ph_gate.5_2_to_5_49: block HELD; re-test after 10 days (Route A lime may still be reacting). Still below 5.5 -> apply one-quarter of the original rate, wait 10 days, re-test. Farm Doctor checks the plan; Owner approves.

route_A.when: block not yet under solarisation plastic
route_A.timing: with compost at start of solarisation; incorporate 15-20 cm; irrigate
route_A.note: two-thirds of full requirement; re-test at end of solarisation; balance after harvest

route_B.when: already solarised and transplant <3 weeks away
route_B.substitute: replace Wk1 Day6 NPK 20-10-10 and Wk2 Day6 NPK 15-15-15 with Calcium Nitrate 2-3 g/L; resume NPK Week 3

lime.fallback: hardwood ash only, max 150 g/m2, counted as ~1/3 strength of hydrated lime
lime.field_note: open field re-limes a season sooner than houses
lime.neem_cake_rule: Neem cake goes in when the solarisation plastic is lifted (T-7), not mid-solarisation. Route A lime at T-35 to T-28 gives a 21-28 day gap. Route B: at least 10 days after the hydrated lime.

soil_and_water.nitrogen_at_planting: urea in the planting hole is DELETED (Rev 5.1); starter P placed near root zone; Calcium Nitrate 2-3 g/L weekly from Day 10-14 after transplant

irrigation.skip_if: net-wall condensation AND soil moist 5 cm deep

grading.criteria: uniform, full colour, firm, no marks; bell 70-90 mm, habanero 35-50 mm
minor cosmetic marks; full size and colour
rot, disease, insect through flesh, soft

triage.see: Silvery flecks/streaks on leaves and tips; tiny slivers that jump
triage.confirm: Tap a tip over white paper; check trap count
triage.first_action: Rotate thrips spray (Spinosad IRAC 5) if over threshold; log and re-count

triage.see: Leaves curl down, tips distort, bronze/greasy sheen, no insect visible
triage.confirm: 10x loupe on youngest tips: glassy oval mites/eggs
triage.first_action: Abamectin or wettable sulphur on tips; remove worst tips

triage.see: Fine webbing under leaves; pale stippling; leaves dry out
triage.first_action: Miticide (rotate); raise humidity slightly; remove worst leaves

triage.see: Sticky honeydew + sooty mould; tiny white flies rise when disturbed
triage.first_action: Thiamethoxam (IRAC 4A) / rotate; traps; sanitation

triage.see: Curled new leaves; soft green/black insect clusters on shoots
triage.first_action: Spray + rotate; remove infested tips

triage.see: Ring/line patterns, mottling, bronzing; stunted one-sided growth
triage.confirm: Pattern + thrips history; lab if unsure
triage.first_action: No cure: rogue and bag; control thrips hard

triage.see: Yellow-green mosaic; puckered distorted growth
triage.confirm: Spreads along a row after pruning
triage.first_action: Rogue and bag; sanitise blade between every plant; wash hands; control aphids

triage.see: Sudden whole-plant wilt; dark lesion at soil-line crown; roots rot
triage.confirm: Cut crown: brown streak; wet soil history
triage.first_action: Improve drainage; Metalaxyl-M drench plant + 4 neighbours; remove dead

triage.see: Wilts by day, recovers at night, then dies; one-sided yellowing
triage.confirm: Cut lower stem: brown vascular ring
triage.first_action: No cure: remove; rotate; solarise

triage.see: Rapid wilt, leaves still green, stem base oozes
triage.confirm: Cut stem in clear water: milky ooze streams
triage.first_action: No cure: remove and bag; stop water spread; no peppers there again

triage.see: Dark water-soaked scabby spots on leaves and fruit
triage.first_action: Copper sprays; remove worst leaves; don't work wet plants

triage.see: Sunken dark concentric spots on fruit; salmon spore ooze
triage.first_action: Remove fruit; rotate fungicide; tighten harvest interval

triage.see: Grey fuzzy mould on stems/fruit in humid corners
triage.first_action: Airflow (prune); remove affected parts; rotate fungicide

triage.see: White powdery patches under leaves; yellow blotches on top
triage.first_action: Sulphur / rotate fungicide; airflow

triage.see: Seedlings topple at soil line; thin water-soaked stem
triage.confirm: Stem pinched and brown at base
triage.first_action: Reduce water; Trichoderma; clean media; discard collapsed

triage.see: Dark sunken leathery patch at fruit bottom
triage.first_action: Ca drench 1.8 kg/1,000 L; regular irrigation

triage.see: Hollow light misshapen pods; poor set; flower drop
triage.first_action: Borax 1 g/L weekly on tips (max 1.5)

triage.see: Pale sunken papery patch on sun-facing side of fruit
triage.confirm: Fruit exposed after heavy leaf strip
triage.first_action: Keep fruit-shading canopy

triage.see: Ring or radial cracks on ripening fruit
triage.first_action: Regular irrigation; steady Ca; harvest promptly in wet spells

triage.see: Chewed pods, entry holes with dark frass; caterpillar inside
triage.confirm: Cut a suspect pod: larva + frass
triage.first_action: IRAC 28 at threshold (3 plants); scout perimeter weekly

triage.see: Roots knotted with galls; stunted, wilting, starved
triage.first_action: No rescue: Gate 0 next cycle; rogue severe plants

triage.see: Seedlings cut off at soil line overnight
triage.confirm: Grey curled larva in soil nearby
triage.first_action: Neem cake; hand-collect at dusk; collars

triage.see: Stunted pale starved plants; stubby thickened roots with dead tips, NO galls; purpling older leaves
triage.first_action: Hold with nitrate nutrition + Ca Nitrate; place P; lime post-harvest (Rev 5.1)

diagnosis_cards.cause: Slender insects rasping leaf/flower; key threat is carrying tospovirus (RC2).
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Traps from day one; IPM; thrips inputs pre-stocked (G1); remove weeds/volunteers.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Trap counts vs threshold (>10/trap or >3/tip); tap tips over white paper; rising trend.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Same-day rotation spray after threshold, rotating by group (see thrips programme; Spinosad IRAC 5 preferred), after 4 PM; re-count.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Microscopic mites on youngest tips; damage looks like virus/herbicide injury.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Loupe scouting of tips; don't carry mites between plants; reduce stress.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Down-curled bronzed tips with no visible insect; loupe shows glassy mites/eggs.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Abamectin or wettable sulphur on tips (rotate, observe PHI); bag worst tips; treat early.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Sap-sucking flies; honeydew -> sooty mould; transmit begomoviruses.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Yellow traps; net-wall vigilance; remove infested lower leaves; weeds.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Clouds when disturbed; >5/trap or >2/leaf; honeydew + mould.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Thiamethoxam (4A) or next group; undersides 4-7 PM; never repeat a group.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Soft insects on shoots/undersides; efficient virus vectors.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Scouting; keep natural enemies; remove infested tips; control ants.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Curled new growth, honeydew, colonies; threshold >5% of plants.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Spray + rotate IRAC; neem/soap if light; cut infested tips.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Tiny mites in hot dry dusty conditions.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Avoid dust/drought stress; scout undersides in dry spells.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Fine webbing, moving specks; stippled then bronzed upper surface.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Miticide (rotate actives); remove worst leaves; fix the stress.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Helicoverpa armigera bores buds/pods; can take 40-60% of habanero.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Weekly perimeter scouting from Week 3; pheromone/light monitoring; Bt for young larvae.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Cream/brown caterpillars; entry holes with frass; pod damage hidden.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: At 3 plants: IRAC 28 0.5 ml/L 4-7 PM; whole field if >10 plants.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Night-feeding caterpillars severing seedlings at soil line.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Neem cake in holes; clean beds; collars.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Seedlings cut overnight; grey curled larva nearby.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Hand-collect at dusk; neem cake; bait only if severe.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Roundworms gall roots; plant can't take up water/nutrients (RC1).
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Gate 0 soil + nematode assay; solarisation 3-4 wks; neem cake; rotation; never replant untested beds.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Stunting, mid-day wilt no spray fixes; beaded galls on pulled roots.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: No rescue: isolate sub-zone; nematode protocol within PHI (Farm Doctor plan, Owner approval); if severe terminate + solarise; fix at Gate 0.

diagnosis_cards.cause: P. capsici in wet, poorly drained soil; crown/root rot, sudden collapse.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Drainage and ridging; 12 cm mulch; avoid waterlogging; Trichoderma; copper in rotation.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Sudden wilt; dark crown lesion; brown streak in cut crown; deaths in wettest spots.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Fix drainage now; Metalaxyl-M drench plant + 4 neighbours (rotation only); remove dead plants.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Soil fungus blocking water vessels; persists for years.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Clean/tested soil; solarisation; rotation; resistant varieties.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Day wilt, night recovery, then death; brown vascular ring.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: No cure: remove; no peppers there without solarisation/rotation.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Ralstonia; rapid wilt with green leaves; spreads in water/soil.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Clean soil; drainage; rotation; tool sanitation; stop water movement.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Fast wilt, green leaves; cut stem in water shows milky threads.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: No cure: remove and bag; stop water spread; solarise; no solanaceous crops there.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Colletotrichum; sunken rotting fruit spots; major market loss.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Airflow; fungicide rotation; remove infected fruit; avoid overhead wetting.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Sunken dark concentric spots; salmon spore ooze.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Destroy infected fruit; rotate to effective fungicide; tighten interval; harvest promptly.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Grey mould on wounded/senescing tissue in humid still air.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: 5 cm gap + door ventilation; remove debris; don't leave wounds wet.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Grey fuzz on stems/flowers/fruit, esp. under large fruit.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Improve airflow; remove affected parts; rotate fungicide.

diagnosis_cards.cause: White powder fungus reducing photosynthesis.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Airflow; avoid dense canopy; sulphur in programme.
diagnosis_cards.detection: White patches (undersides first), yellow blotches on top; wipes off.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Sulphur or rotate fungicide; remove worst leaves; open canopy.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Soil fungi collapsing seedlings in wet crowded nurseries.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Clean media/trays; don't over-water; airflow; Trichoderma media.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Seedlings topple; pinched brown stem base.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Cut watering; airflow; discard collapsed; Trichoderma drench.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Thrips-borne TSWV (RC2); incurable once systemic.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Control thrips from day one (G1/G2); remove weed hosts; rogue early.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Ring/line patterns, bronzing, one-sided stunting; match thrips history; lab if unsure.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: No cure: rogue and bag; hit thrips hard (same-day).

diagnosis_cards.cause: Sap-transmitted on blades and hands during pruning.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Sanitise blade between every plant; wash hands; rogue; control aphids; avoid tobacco.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Mosaic/mottle, puckered leaves; affected line follows pruning direction.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: No cure: rogue and bag; reinforce sanitation; remove source plants.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Calcium gap or irregular water during fruit fill.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Never miss Ca drench; regular irrigation; split Ca Day 1/Day 4.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Dark sunken leathery patch at blossom end.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Ca Nitrate drench 1.8 kg/1,000 L; regularise water.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Endemic Niger Delta deficiency.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Borax 1 g/L weekly on tips through set; 4 h from Ca.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Hollow deformed pods; poor set; flower drop despite good pest control.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Borax exactly 1 g/L weekly; never >1.5 g/L.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Sunscald: exposed fruit burns. Cracking: dry spell then flood.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Keep fruit-shading canopy; steady irrigation; steady Ca.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Pale papery sun-side patch; ring/radial splits.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Restore canopy; regular irrigation; harvest promptly in wet spells.

diagnosis_cards.cause: pH <5.5: Al/Mn toxic to root tips; P locked; Ca/Mg leached (Rev 5.1).
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Gate 0 pH test; lime in solarisation window; re-test every cycle.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Stunted, pale; stubby thickened roots, dead tips, NO galls; purpling older leaves; pH test.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: No mid-cycle fix: nitrate nutrition + Ca Nitrate; place P; lime post-harvest.

diagnosis_cards.cause: Bacteria (Xanthomonas) spread by rain splash, wet handling, tools and infected transplants; worst in warm wet weather.
diagnosis_cards.prevention: Clean seedlings; copper in the fungicide rotation; drip not overhead water; don't work plants when wet; sanitise tools; remove crop debris.
diagnosis_cards.detection: Small water-soaked leaf spots turning dark and scabby with a yellow halo; raised scabby spots on fruit; spreads after rain.
diagnosis_cards.treatment: Copper sprays (M1) in rotation; remove worst leaves; stop handling wet plants. Infected tissue does not recover.
diagnosis_cards.status: drafted from Rev 5 triage + standard agronomy; review at the Gate 4 cycle review

root_read.when: any plant still collapsed by 6 PM from Day 3 after transplant

week_counting.rule: Transplant day = T = Day 1 of Week 0. Week n covers days 7n+1 to 7n+7 (Week 0 = days 1-7, Week 1 = days 8-14). week = floor((date - T) / 7).
week_counting.pre_transplant: Pre-plant tasks are scheduled as days before transplant (T-n), not as week days.
week_counting.note: Rev 5 p2 'Week 1 = days 2-8' is an error and is superseded.

alert_deadlines.thrips: treat at the same day's spray window (4-7 PM); if the breach is logged after 7 PM, the next day's window
alert_deadlines.all_other_thresholds: next spray window, never later than 24 h

product_rule: Any product without an IRAC or FRAC group on file cannot be selected for a treatment. Groups are entered once, from the label, when the product is added to stock.
zones_note: IDs follow the Rev 5.1 block register. OF-02 is now the nursery.

nursery.why: Seedlings carry thrips, tospovirus and damping-off into every block; the nursery is the first green bridge.
rules: Nursery media must be clean: sterilised, solarised or bought-in; never raw soil from a cropping block.
Daily trap count and a twice-weekly seedling check (thrips, damping-off, virus symptoms).
No old crop debris, culls or volunteer peppers within 5 m of the nursery; crop waste is burned or buried far from it (Rev 5).
Staff move nursery first, cropping blocks after; never from a block back into the nursery the same day without washing hands and changing over-clothes.
Damping-off, virus or thrips above threshold in the nursery opens an alert like any other zone.
seedling_release_check: no thrips on a tap test
batch ID recorded against the block it goes to
nursery.gate_link: Seedling release check is added to Gate 1; a block cannot log transplant without a released seedling batch.

farm_doctor.role: In-app diagnostic and planning assistant that takes the place of the site agronomist for day-to-day decisions. It advises; people decide.
does: Guided diagnosis: symptom -> triage row -> card -> confirm test, asking for photos and the confirm step before naming a cause.
Differentials: names look-alikes and the test that separates them (e.g. nematode galls vs acid-soil stubby roots; Fusarium vs bacterial wilt water test).
Photo review when online, with a stated confidence (high / medium / low).
Treatment plan that already passes every rule: Gate 3, IRAC/FRAC rotation, PHI, REI, mixing rules, spray timing, Week 10 organics-only, product in stock.
Dose calculator: label or schedule rate -> amount per 16 L knapsack and per 500 L / 1,000 L tank.
Lime calculator: pH readings + texture + bed area -> route, product and kg.
Gate reviews: checks the evidence for Gates 0, 1 and 4 against the rules and lists anything missing.
Follow-up: schedules a check 3 days after each treatment and records whether it worked.
Cycle review draft for Gate 4 from the season's records.
never: Clears a gate, confirms its own diagnosis, or approves its own plan.
Recommends a product that is not in the active-ingredient catalogue, not in stock, or blocked by rotation/PHI.
Invents a dose where neither the schedule nor an entered label gives one.
Names a virus or bacterial disease as confirmed on a photo alone.

confirmation.diagnosis: Field Supervisor or Farm Manager performs the confirm test and confirms

lab_required_for: Gate 0 soil + nematode assay (cannot be replaced by the app)
suspected tospovirus or other virus when the pattern is unclear
bacterial wilt if the water test is inconclusive
any diagnosis the Farm Doctor rates low confidence twice
farm_doctor.offline: Rules-based guided diagnosis, calculators and plan checks work with no signal; photo review needs a connection.
farm_doctor.record: Every Farm Doctor output is saved with what it read, its confidence, and who confirmed it.

active_ingredients.schedule_rate: 150 ml cold-pressed oil + 30 ml soap / 16 L

labels.rule: Treatments are chosen by active ingredient. Brand products are optional labels attached to an active ingredient.
manager_adds_label: select one or more active ingredients from the catalogue (group fills in automatically)
brand name and formulation (e.g. 45SC, 80WP) and concentration
label PHI and REI (blank allowed: defaults apply)
labels.rate_rule: Dose comes from the schedule rate for that active and formulation, or from an entered label. If neither exists, the product cannot be used until a label rate is entered.
labels.unknown_brands: Punch, Vanguish and Lion Seal are removed until a manager enters them as labels against their active ingredients.
labels.new_active: An active ingredient not in the catalogue can only be added by the Owner, with its IRAC/FRAC group.

thrips_program.rule: Rotate thrips treatments by group, never the same group twice running.
thrips_program.note: Actives without a schedule rate need a label entered before use.
